Version History¶

Version history and migration guide. For each release changes may affect Prism, or Lente, or both. A Migration Guide section is provided if any changes on the client side are required.

Some features are implemented in a previous version as experimental, and when that is the case it is mentioned. Note that not all cited versions are released as Docker images.

Prism/Lente version should match major/minor version. For example Prism/Lente version should match 0.8.x, where x can/will be different. Do not use Prism 0.8.x with Lente 0.7.x, or vice versa.

Ver 0.9.x¶

The major change in 0.9 is a new user interface for both Prism and Lente, built on NiceGUI, replacing the Flask/Bokeh interface. See Prism and Lente screenshots.

  • Lente Results Analytics page, with yield, pareto and test runtime charts

  • Lente Station Manager can automatically sync scripts to stations, auto_sync_scripts

  • Lente Station Manager git pull button, see public/git_pull_watcher.sh

  • Script sync sends all of public/prism, and the station replaces its whole public/prism folder, so files removed on Lente are also removed on the stations

  • Script sync size limit and exclusions, see Script Sync Exclusions

  • site_key in settings.json replaces the built-in encryption keys, and the Station Manager shows any station whose site_key does not match

  • License files are signed, see Migration Guide below

  • New Prism stations no longer need a git clone of the scripts repo. Lente serves prism.sh, and on first start Prism downloads its scripts from Lente. See Deployment.

  • Lente builds the scripts package for stations on demand, when it is missing or older than public/VERSION

  • Station Manager user sync matches users by email. Synced users that are left out of a later sync are deactivated on the station.

  • Station requests are refused when no station password is configured

  • Vendor programming tools are no longer bundled, see Migration Guide below

  • Lente DASHBOARD role, a read-only results viewer that is not logged out when idle, see Accounts

  • Lente menus only list the pages the user’s roles can open

  • With use_https, stations only connect to a computer with the site’s cert.pem, see HTTPS

  • Test Portal channel number buttons start just that channel, while other channels keep testing

  • Station Manager Restart asks for confirmation when a selected station is in use

Bug fixes,

  • [BUGFIX] Station Manager user sync (SYNCUSERS) failed on Prism, and sent every user instead of only SERVERSYNC users

  • [BUGFIX] Stations with auto_sync_scripts off were treated as on by Lente

  • [BUGFIX] Auto script sync could start more than one sync for a station, and its timer was not reset

  • [BUGFIX] Lente to upstream Lente result uploads used the wrong password (lente_lente_pw)

  • [BUGFIX] Prism and Lente were slow to exit on shutdown

  • [BUGFIX] With use_https, script sync from Lente failed

  • [BUGFIX] Script and user syncs could interrupt a station’s test runner once the operator logged out. Syncs now wait until the Script Runner is exited.

  • [BUGFIX] Auto script sync could restart a station a user had just logged in to, logging them out. Prism now refuses a script sync while a user is logged in.

  • [BUGFIX] Logging out of Prism left the Script Runner loaded, which blocked syncs. Logging out now exits the Script Runner, once any running tests finish.

  • [BUGFIX] Prism allowed a second user to log in from another browser

  • [BUGFIX] A Prism browser closed without logging out blocked other browsers from logging in until the idle timeout. Closing the browser now logs out, and a login can take over the other browser’s session.

  • [BUGFIX] Prism, Lente and scripts versions showed the number of the previous commit. Prism and Lente logs now include the commit hash.

Migration Guide¶

  • prism_lente_pw (and lente_lente_pw) must now be set in settings.json, otherwise all station requests are refused. See settings.json.

  • manifest_pw is no longer used and can be removed from settings.json.

  • Copy the updated hooks/pre-commit into your scripts repo’s .git/hooks, see Development.

  • site_key must be set in settings.json, the same on every computer. It replaces result_encrypt_pw, which can be removed. Travellers, manifests and encrypted results made by earlier versions can’t be read, so travellers must be recreated. See settings.json.

  • License files (public/sistemi.lic) from earlier versions are no longer accepted. Contact Sistemi for a new license file.

  • Vendor programming tools (Nordic nrfjprog, ST STM32CubeProgrammer) are no longer included in public/prism/drivers. They will be installed on the host computer.

  • With “demo”: false the demo @here.com users are deactivated at startup, see Demo Users and the First Admin.

  • Prism no longer has a self sign up page, accounts are created by an Admin.

  • With use_https, every Prism/Lente computer of a site needs the same public/cert.pem and public/key.pem. An upstream Lente needs a certificate from a public certificate authority. See HTTPS.

Ver 0.8.x¶

This is the first version where this type of information will be tracked.

The major features released in 0.8 are,

  • support for OPCUA, which is a Manufacturing Execution System (MES) to facilitate the monitoring of the Prism/Lente deployment by other OPCUA tools.

  • Docker Image OS uses Ubuntu 24.04.

  • Update to Python 3.12 for development and Docker Image.

In addition new features have been added to make it easier to debug deployment issues, get logs, and otherwise monitor the system.

Prism¶

0.8.37¶

  • [BUGFIX] Fix/improve getting self IP address (implemented in 0.7.52)

  • Support for OPC UA, see OPCUA

  • Test portal layout supports up to 8 test channels (jigs per Prism PC) (implemented in 0.7.43)

  • Index page shows time and date (implemented in 0.7.56)

  • Auto config test on startup, see settings.json (implemented in 0.7.64)

  • Test Portal layout includes script Info section in title bar

  • Health Checks, see Health Checks

  • [BUGFIX] Text entry box entry was incorrect when user timeout occurred (fixed in 0.7.73)

Lente¶

0.8.21¶

  • [BUGFIX] Fix/improve getting self IP address

  • Support for OPC UA, see OPCUA

  • Station Management portal can remotely,

    • request Prism Log (implemented in 0.7.48)

    • reboot Prism computer (implemented in 0.7.66)

Migration Guide¶

  • None

Ver 0.7.x¶

Prism/Lente version 0.7.x are deprecated and no longer supported. However the images are still available on Docker Hub and can be used via the helper scripts prism.sh/lente.sh.
